description: Get an end-of-day quote for a semiconductor stock covered by VLSI Korea market data (~113 tickers). Match by slug, ticker (e.g. '000660' or '000660.KS'), or company name (e.g. 'SK hynix'). Daily change % is computed from the last two daily closes. Delayed EOD data, not investment advice.
